content: In the section, we present the performance of two well-established baseline models to automatically infer the phenotype based on the patient note, which we approach as a multi-label, multi-class text classification task BIBREF18. Each of the baseline model is a binary classifier indicating whether a given phenotype is present in the input patient note. As a result, we train a separate model for each phenotype.
